text:
Harper Liu: Elmbridge (midmarket) dipped ~60% last night. Trial ends in 11 days. I want to run a short "reactivation sprint": quick tech fix + soft pause + low-cost credit.

Kai Morgan: quick context? what broke?

Harper Liu: they tried bulk import and hit schema mismatch + timeout. Health 71 -> 34, billing unset. One onboarding call but no follow-up.

Zara Ahmed: 34 is worrying but fixable. What's the sprint look like?

Harper Liu: Proposed steps: 1) Offer 30-day "soft pause" keeping data and read-only access; 2) 25-minute hands-on lab to patch schema and run a sample job; 3) 1500 token trial credit + priority chat for 7 days; 4) two-question poll in the session: reason for stall + intent to continue; 5) instrument events: `schema_patch_applied`, `sample_job_passed`, `soft_pause_enabled`.

BillingOps: approve credits up to 2000 tokens per case. Need claim flow.

Kai Morgan: can we make the pause opt-in via a single reply? we should avoid manual ops.

Harper Liu: yes — portal supports pause flag. I'll include an easy reply CTA in the email and also a Calendly link for the lab.

Zara Ahmed: I'll create two templates: pause offer + reactivation nudge. Also add a tiny checklist for the lab: sample CSV, access token, run the one-click test.

playbook-bot: Reminder: Calendly link missing for Elmbridge (assigned to Zara Ahmed).

Harper Liu: draft email snippet: 
```
Hi {{first_name}},
We noticed your import hit a snag. We can pause your trial for 30 days and keep your data safe while we fix the import. Book a 25-min lab here: {{calendly}} or reply to accept the pause. We'll also grant 1500 token credit to test the fix.
```

Kai Morgan: good. Add GIF of the one-click test and an explicit CTA to accept pause or book lab.

Zara Ahmed: adding GIF and Calendly now. Will push templates to the playbook doc and tag BillingOps for the credit flow.

Harper Liu: tagging @Kai to add events to Elmbridge customer stream so CS dashboard shows outcomes.

Kai Morgan: will add `schema_patch_applied` and `sample_job_passed` events and a small cohort card.

Harper Liu: cadence: immediate outreach, lab within 48 hours if they book, auto-reminder at 7 days, 25-day retention expiry alert. If `sample_job_passed` fires, CSM does a 1:1 within 48 hours.

Zara Ahmed: checklist before send: templates done (Zara), calendly+GIF (Zara), pause flag tested (Product), credit flow (BillingOps), events wired (Kai), outreach (Harper).

Harper Liu: sending outreach now. Will update thread with booking/result. :rocket: 

Harper Liu: update 1770000231 — Elmbridge booked lab for Thu 2pm. Running sprint tomorrow, will report back.
